text: 纳斯达克金龙中国指数涨幅扩大至3.2%，中概股小鹏涨8%，小米ADR涨6.2%，联想ADR涨5.9%，阿里涨5.8%，拼多多涨5.1%，日月光半导体涨4.7%，腾讯ADR涨3.3%，比亚迪ADR涨3.2%，百度涨3.1%，京东、美团ADR、新东方至少涨超2.8%，网易涨1.9%。 ETF中，KWEB涨3.9%，CQQQ涨3.3%。 富时A50夜期涨0.45%。
text_en: The Nasdaq Golden Dragon China Index extended gains to 3.2%, with Chinese concept stocks Xpeng up 8%, Xiaomi ADR up 6.2%, Lenovo ADR up 5.9%, Alibaba up 5.8%, Pinduoduo up 5.1%, ASE Technology up 4.7%, Tencent ADR up 3.3%, BYD ADR up 3.2%, Baidu up 3.1%, and JD.com, Meituan ADR and New Oriental up at least 2.8%, while NetEase rose 1.9%. Among ETFs, KWEB rose 3.9% and CQQQ rose 3.3%. FTSE A50 night futures rose 0.45%.
